en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a coastal village with rocky foreground, scattered trees, and a small harbor with piers and wooden houses along the shoreline. More houses are visible on low wooded hills in the background. In the lower-left corner, the word "STENUNGSON" is printed, and in the lower-right corner there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 5175.
